Extracts full Open Graph metadata from a page

```elixir title="Elixir"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.og_title)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.og_type)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.og_image)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.og_description)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.title)
```
